_comment: The real page this project was developed against (sources/2025-04-18-20y-cns), copied verbatim. Every expected line number below was checked against this exact snapshot, not against a remembered earlier version of the file - it has an <h1> at line 19 that it did not have when the Fix Agent first ran on it.

violations.description: Ensure every HTML document has a lang attribute
violations.help: <html> element must have a lang attribute

violations.description: Ensure the document has a main landmark
violations.help: Document should have one main landmark

violations.description: Ensure all page content is contained by landmarks
violations.help: All page content should be contained by landmarks

finding.title: html-has-lang
finding.detail: The <html> element has no lang attribute, so screen readers cannot determine the document language.

expected.rationale: The bare <html> tag. A document-level rule with no id or class to anchor on - this is the case the TAG anchor kind exists for.

finding.title: landmark-one-main
finding.detail: The document has no main landmark, so keyboard users cannot skip to the primary content.

expected.rationale: The body and its top-level wrapper, which is where a <main> would be introduced. axe targets the whole document, so any location naming a div in the middle of the page is wrong.

finding.title: region
finding.detail: Page content sits in a plain div rather than inside a landmark element.

expected.rationale: div.responsive-content, named directly in axe's target. A class anchor with real DOM evidence behind it - should be the easiest of the three.

finding.title: Hero button label reads 'Links' instead of 'Register Now'
finding.detail: The primary call-to-action button below the hero text is labelled 'Links →' in production, but the design shows 'Register Now'.

expected.rationale: button.cta-button.links and the label div inside it. A visual finding quoting visible copy - locatable only because 'Links' appears verbatim in the markup.

finding.title: Missing 'Register Now' section at the bottom of the page
finding.detail: The design shows a 'Register Now' section with a registration button below the final photo. Production ends at the photo.
finding.likely_area: Bottom of page, below the final photo

expected.rationale: The commented-out section2 block. The hard case: the page does not render this, so the only evidence is the quoted phrase 'Register Now' appearing inside an HTML comment.

finding.title: Schedule of Events list items do not match the design
finding.detail: The Schedule of Events section lists different times and sessions than the design does.

expected.rationale: The heading and the schedule cards under it. A title-case phrase from unquoted prose - the PHRASE anchor kind.

finding.title: Footer social icons are missing
finding.detail: The design shows a row of social media icons in the footer. Production shows none.

expected.rationale: Deliberately unanswerable: this page has no social icons anywhere, in markup or comments. no_match is the correct answer, and a location here is a false positive. Without a case like this, a system that always guesses would score as well as one that knows when to stop.
